_doc: Real Copter regressions from ArduPilot master history (public). Each case: the commit that
introduced the bug (culprit), the commit that fixed it, and what the bug does, read from the
fix commit by hand. Found with bench/real/szz.py, then every pair checked manually.
kind: escaped = lived on master for weeks or more and passed upstream CI the whole time;
series = fixed within days, usually inside the same unit-conversion PR series;
negative = a commit that should NOT change flight behaviour (false-alarm control).
Benchmark protocol (bench/real/run_real.py): baseline = culprit^, candidate = culprit, test
code pinned to culprit^. Detection is scored before the fix commit is ever looked at.
split: fixed before any new scenario was written (seed 20261003); poshold_brake_units forced into dev because it was examined first. Holdout cases are run once, after dev tuning is frozen.
2026-10-03: rtl_descent_trunc and bendyruler_sign culprits corrected (SZZ had blamed commits where the buggy line already existed); found by known_bugs.py verify, before either case was run.
